_note: ArmnetBench v0.1, single-arm. Eight tasks, the teleoperated demonstrations that define each, and the public checkpoints. Published success rates are in reference_results.csv. act/diffusion/smolvla are lerobot checkpoints; pi0 and pi0.5 are openpi (JAX) and grootn1.7/molmoact2 need their own runtimes, so only the first three are loadable here - diffusion needs lerobot 0.6 because 0.5.1 refuses the mixed image sizes.

block_stack.instruction: Stack the colouful blocks on top of each other

cable_clip.instruction: Push the Displayport cable into the cable holder on the white block
cable_clip._note: every one of the seven policies scores exactly 0.000 on this task

cable_unclip.instruction: Remove the power cable from cable holder

eye_drops_to_basket.instruction: Put the eye drops into the basket

eye_drops_to_shelf.instruction: Put the eye drops on the shelf

ring_insert.instruction: Insert the colourful ring into the central wooden peg

tool_insert.instruction: Insert the missing tool into the empty slot on the toolbox

tool_removal.instruction: Remove the small middle tool (3/8 Extension Bar 75mm) from the toolbox
